content.text: Validated on the 2.0→2.1 cut — notes matched the manual list plus two forgotten schema enum values.
SDK changelogs were hand-written and often missed OpenAPI-only additions. Consumers need accurate minor-version notes without relying on tribal knowledge.

Done when CI on the SDK repo runs an OpenAPI diff against the previous minor tag and generates a markdown release-notes fragment (added/removed/changed operations and schemas) attached to the GitHub release and npm package README section.
